lastCompletedStory.title: Inject git diff main...HEAD into the codex reviewer instructions

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-354) is done: CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv('reviewer', ...) now computes `git diff main...HEAD` + `git diff --name-only main...HEAD` at dispatch time (computeReviewerDiff/renderReviewerDiffBlock, backend-adapter.ts) and appends it to the codex reviewer's /tmp model_instructions_file body (writeCodexInstructionsFile grew an optional appendedBlock param), with an explicit 'review ONLY this diff' directive. Injection is strictly reviewer-scoped: implementer/planner/auditor call renderActor with appendedInstructionsBlock left undefined, and ClaudeAdapter is completely untouched (golden tests in backend-adapter.test.ts pass verbatim, unedited). SpawnArgvOptions grew an optional `cwd?: string` field (defaults to process.cwd() inside renderReviewerDiffBlock) consumed only by CodexAdapter's reviewer branch -- production call sites (review.ts, plan-runner.ts) never pass it, only the new real-fixture-git-repo tests in codex-adapter.test.ts do. Failure modes are all well-formed markers, never a crash/empty-string: missing/unresolvable 'main' ref or any git failure -> '[diff-unavailable: ...]', empty diff -> '[no-changes: the current branch has no diff vs main]', diff over 200_000 chars -> hard-truncated with a visible '[diff truncated at ...]' marker. If a future story wants this same grounding for the codex IMPLEMENTER/planner/auditor (they don't self-ground the way the claude reviewer's Bash `git diff` step does), reuse computeReviewerDiff/renderReviewerDiffBlock as-is -- they're generic despite the 'Reviewer' name, just wire a call into the other renderActor branches.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed `git diff A...B` (three-dot) diffs merge-base(A,B) against B, i.e. 'branch changes since diverging from main' -- matches the implementation's use of `git diff main...HEAD`, not a direct two-way tip compare.
